title: Every email lead a flow drafts to can be followed in Frequency's CRM, from draft to signed up or said no
description: The Owner sends hunt drafts by hand and marks them sent, replied or said no, but Frequency only learns counts per draft (FW-C-055), so a lead cannot be opened in Frequency's CRM to see what was said and where it stands. Frequency now takes one draft's state at /api/webhooks/flowweb-crm (frequency-web LIVE-2256), signed like the outcomes pull, and keeps one contact and one conversation per lead. Make fwd post each email draft's state there: soon after start and daily with the outcomes pull, right after each mark, and on POST /v1/flows/neighborhood-activation/crm/sync. Only drafts to an email address are posted, never a form or social draft and never a draft rejected without being sent; a draft whose marks have not changed since its last good sync is not posted again the same day. Write Frequency's answer onto the draft as crm { status, at, lead_status, signed_up, conversation_url, error } and show it in GET /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/drafts. A Frequency that is down never fails a mark. Nothing is sent to the lead.
acceptance: Soon after start fwd posts each email draft, signed with crd_frequencyoutcomes, and records crm synced with Frequency's lead_status and conversation_url
Form and social drafts, and drafts rejected without being sent, are never posted
A sync with nothing changed posts nothing; a mark posts the draft again with the new mark
GET .../drafts shows crm on each draft
With Frequency down a mark still answers 200 and the draft records crm failed
